newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FERC okays PG&E, Valero Natural Gas merger.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FERC okays PG&E, Valero Natural Gas merger.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Wednesday approved PG&E Corp's plan to acquire Valero Energy Corp's Valero Natural Gas Co.

With the FERC approval, PG&E expects to complete the $1.5 billion purchase of Valero's natural gas and gas liquids pipelines, gas processing plants and storage facilities by August 1, a company spokesman said.

The deal to buy Valero is PG&E's third recent investment in the natural gas industry in Texas, with the aim of positioning it to become one of the top 10 U.S. gas marketing operations with daily sales of 3.6 billion cubic feet of gas.
